ruleset.name: project
ruleset.description: PMD's official quickstart ruleset without the rule that conflicts with Spring Boot and ArchUnit: "classes with only static members should not be instantiable" treats the @SpringBootApplication class with only a main method, and architecture test classes with only @ArchTest static fields, as utility classes, but both must be instantiated. The rule was called UseUtilityClass before PMD 7.18 and InstantiableUtilityClass after, so both names are excluded.
